news.title: Mac Hotels Limited to Report Second Half, 2026 Results on May 30, 2026
news.body: Mac Hotels Limited announced that they will report second half, 2026 results on May 30, 2026

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Desiderio Misquita was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Mac Hotels Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 300.762688 million in funding from Parasrampuria Infrastructure Llp, Hotel Miramar Comfort Pvt Ltd, Mangal Keshav Capital Limited, DCAK PRIVATE LIMITED
news.body: Mac Hotels Limited announces a private placement with Parasrampuria Infrastructure LLP, Hotel Miramar Comfort Pvt Ltd, Mangal Keshav Capital Limited and others to issue 4,800,500 Equity Shares at a price of INR 45 per share for gross proceeds of INR 216,022,500 and 7,368,712 convertible warrants at a price of INR 11.5 per warrant for proceeds of INR 84,740,188 for aggregate proceeds of INR 300,762,688 on February 19, 2026.
